justification: Insufficient modularization is present: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriter.java` defines `Default` starting at line 1795 and it runs to the end of the 6,795-line file. The class contains four static factory methods (`forCreation`, `forRedefinition`, `forRebasing`, `forDecoration`), the main `make` workflow plus abstract `create`, and many distinct nested subsystems (`UnresolvedType`, `SignatureKey`, `ValidatingClassVisitor`, `Constraint` with multiple enum implementations, and later `InitializationHandler`/`FrameWriter`/`Dispatcher` helpers). I counted 309 member declarations at and below the `Default` declaration, which indicates a large, multi-responsibility class that could be split into smaller abstractions.
